secrets.name: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
secrets.description: Key for the Emergent object-storage proxy (integrations.emergentagent.com) used by POST /api/uploads. Without it gym-registration image uploads fail with 502; browsing/search/admin work regardless.

secrets.name: WP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Base URL of a WordPress site running the smart-body-core plugin (wordpress/smart-body-core). Without it the API serves the built-in sample catalog.

secrets.name: WP_USERNAME
secrets.description: Optional. WordPress user for read/write access to the smart-body-core REST namespace.

secrets.name: WP_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional. WordPress application password matching WP_USERNAME; enables writing registrations to WordPress.
